message.content: {"reasoning":"The defendant was a business employee who, using his position, intercepted and misappropriated company funds (280,600 yuan) for more than three months before returning the money. This conduct matches the crime of misappropriating entrusted funds in a private entity, which is classified under Chinese criminal law as 挪用资金 (embezzlement of specific funds). No other criminal conduct is described.", "final_answer":"[罪名]挪用资金<eoa>"}
message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: Lin, a business employee (salesperson) of a company, used his position to misappropriate company funds (280,600 yuan) collected by the company, held for more than three months, then returned all money after being caught. This is typical of "挪用特定款物" or "挪用资金" or "职务侵占". In Chinese criminal law, "挪用特定款物罪" applies when a person in a position of trust (e.g., employee) misappropriates funds entrusted to them. "职务侵占罪" is for state employees? Actually, "职务侵占罪" applies to state employees, not private. For private sector, "挪用特定款物罪" (embezzlement of specific funds) is used. Also "挪用资金" is a term used in examples: earlier example: "挪用资金" for a travel agency employee misusing travel funds. That matches. So the crime is "挪用资金". In examples they label as "挪用资金". So answer: [罪名]挪用资金<eoa>
